output.summary: A perennial herbaceous orchid widespread across central and southern Europe, North Africa and the Middle East. Its flower has a hairy, variably patterned petal resembling a bee’s abdomen; northern populations are almost exclusively self-pollinating, while a solitary bee pollinates it in the Mediterranean region.
output.edibilityNote: Root tubers were ground into salep in the Ottoman Empire; salep remains used in traditional dishes in Turkey and across the Middle East.
